verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a Machines REST API, but the evidence pack contains no API versioning scheme and no documented deprecation policy. The marketing line "The API you start with is the API you keep" is a general stability claim about primitives, not a versioned-API or deprecation commitment. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
